mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.news_id, f.create_time, n.title, n.author, n.sources, n.dates, n.hits, n.types FROM news_favorite f LEFT JOIN New_Notice n ON f.news_id = n.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER} AND n.deletes = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
